verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना ।हनूमन्तम् स्थितम् पार्श्वे वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-३७-१॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā ।hanūmantam sthitam pārśve vacanam ca idam abravīt ॥4-37-1॥

translations.english: Having heard the great Lakshmana Sugriva said to Hanuman, the minister who stood by his side:
translations.hindi: दसक लिए तुम सुके क्षमा किष्किन्धाकाएड का छत्तीसवाँ सग पूरा हुआ |. — सप्तत्रिशः सग; < 8 ७५०० ५ एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । हन्नुमन्त स्थितं पाश्वे सचिवं त्ञिदमत्रज्रीत्‌

verses.sloka: महेन्द्र हिमवत् विंध्य कैलास शिखरेषु च ।मन्दरे पाण्डु शिखरे पंच शैलेषु ये स्थिताः ॥४-३७-२॥
verses.transliteration: mahendra himavat viṁdhya kailāsa śikhareṣu ca ।mandare pāṇḍu śikhare paṁca śaileṣu ye sthitāḥ ॥4-37-2॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.
translations.hindi: जो वानर महेन्द्राचल, हिमाचल, विन्ध्याचल, कैलासशिखर और श्वेतशिखर वाले मन्दराचल् पर रहते हैँ

verses.sloka: तरुण आदित्य वर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु नित्यशः ।पर्वतेषु समुद्र अंते पश्चिमस्याम् तु ये दिशि ॥४-३७-३॥
verses.transliteration: taruṇa āditya varṇeṣu bhrājamāneṣu nityaśaḥ ।parvateṣu samudra aṁte paścimasyām tu ye diśi ॥4-37-3॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.
translations.hindi: तथा जो पश्चिम दिशा में तरुण सूर्य तुल्य वर्ण बाले वानर, सदा प्रकाशमान, समुद्र तटवर्ती पर्बतों पर रहते हैं

verses.sloka: आदित्य भवने चैव गिरौ संध्या अभ्र संनिभे ।पद्म ताल वनम् भीमाः संश्रिता हरि पुंगवाः ॥४-३७-४॥
verses.transliteration: āditya bhavane caiva girau saṁdhyā abhra saṁnibhe ।padma tāla vanam bhīmāḥ saṁśritā hari puṁgavāḥ ॥4-37-4॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.
translations.hindi: आदित्यभवने? चैव गिरो सन्ध्याश्रसन्निभे । जु पद्मतालवनं भीमं संश्रिता हरिषुङ्गवाः ।!!४॥ तथा सन्ध्याकालीन मेघ की तरह उदयाचल ओर अस्ताचळः पर और पद्मताल वन में जो भयङ्कर आकार वाले श्रेष्ठवानर रहते हैं.

verses.sloka: अंजन अंबुद संकाशाः कुंजर प्रतिम ओजसः ।अंजने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवंगमाः ॥४-३७-५॥
verses.transliteration: aṁjana aṁbuda saṁkāśāḥ kuṁjara pratima ojasaḥ ।aṁjane parvate caiva ye vasanti plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-37-5॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.
translations.hindi: वनेष्‌ च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिपु महत्सु च। तापसानां च रम्येप वनान्तेप समन्ततः ॥८!! तथा जो बानर उन अत्यन्त सुवासित ओर रमणीय समस्त बनों में, जहाँ तपस्वियो के रमणीय आश्रम हैं, दास करते हें ॥=॥ तांस्तान्‌ समानय क्षिपं पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्‌ । DN 25 सामदानादिभिः #सवराशु प्रेपय वानरान्‌

verses.sloka: महाशैल गुहा आवासा वानराः कनक प्रभाः ।मेरु पार्श्व गताः चैव ये च धूम्र गिरिम् श्रिताः ॥४-३७-६॥
verses.transliteration: mahāśaila guhā āvāsā vānarāḥ kanaka prabhāḥ ।meru pārśva gatāḥ caiva ye ca dhūmra girim śritāḥ ॥4-37-6॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

verses.sloka: तरुण आदित्य वर्णाः च पर्वते ये महाअरुणे ।पिबंतो मधु मैरेयम् भीम वेगाः प्लवंगमाः ॥४-३७-७॥
verses.transliteration: taruṇa āditya varṇāḥ ca parvate ye mahāaruṇe ।pibaṁto madhu maireyam bhīma vegāḥ plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-37-7॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.
translations.hindi: तथा जो सुनहूली आभा वाले वानर, वनों में, पेत की कन्द राओं मे रहते हैं तथा जो मेरुपवेत की वरल में रहने वाले तथा धूम्रपवत पर रहने बाले हैं ॥ तरुणा दित्यवर्णाश्च पवते च महारुणे | पिबन्तो मधु मेरेयं भीमवेगाः पुबङ्गसा;

verses.sloka: वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च ।तापस आश्रम रम्येषु वन अन्तेषु समंततः ॥४-३७-८॥
verses.transliteration: vaneṣu ca suramyeṣu sugandhiṣu mahatsu ca ।tāpasa āśrama ramyeṣu vana anteṣu samaṁtataḥ ॥4-37-8॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

verses.sloka: तान् तान् त्वम् आनय क्षिप्रम् पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानरान् ।साम दान आदिभिः कल्पैः वानरैः वेगवत्तरैः ॥४-३७-९॥
verses.transliteration: tān tān tvam ānaya kṣipram pṛthivyām sarva vānarān ।sāma dāna ādibhiḥ kalpaiḥ vānaraiḥ vegavattaraiḥ ॥4-37-9॥

translations.english: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

verses.sloka: प्रेषिताः प्रथमम् ये च मया आज्ञाताः महाजवाः ।त्वरण अर्थम् तु भूयः त्वम् संप्रेषय हरीश्वरान् ॥४-३७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: preṣitāḥ prathamam ye ca mayā ājñātāḥ mahājavāḥ ।tvaraṇa artham tu bhūyaḥ tvam saṁpreṣaya harīśvarān ॥4-37-10॥

translations.english: 'This is in addition to the monkeys for whom swiftfooted messengers have already been sent.
translations.hindi: मैंने शीघ्रगासी जिन दृतों को पहले भेजा था, उनसे अपने काम शीघ्रतापूबेक पूरा कराने के लिए, तुम फिर और वानर भेजो

verses.sloka: ये प्रसक्ताः च कामेषु दीर्घ सूत्राः च वानराः ।इह आनयस्व तान् शीघ्रम् सर्वान् एव कपीश्वरान् ॥४-३७-११॥
verses.transliteration: ye prasaktāḥ ca kāmeṣu dīrgha sūtrāḥ ca vānarāḥ ।iha ānayasva tān śīghram sarvān eva kapīśvarān ॥4-37-11॥

translations.english: 'Get all the monkeys including those engaged in carnal pleasures and those slow in movement all at once on my command.
translations.hindi: जो वानर कामासक्त हैं या दोर्घसूत्री हैं, उनको मेरी आज्ञा सुना कर, तुरन्त यहां बुलवा तो

verses.sloka: अहोभिः दशभिः ये च न आगच्छन्ति मम आज्ञया ।हन्तव्याः ते दुरात्मानो राज शासन दूषकाः ॥४-३७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: ahobhiḥ daśabhiḥ ye ca na āgacchanti mama ājñayā ।hantavyāḥ te durātmāno rāja śāsana dūṣakāḥ ॥4-37-12॥

translations.english: 'Kill those evilminded ones within ten days for disobeying the royal orders.

verses.sloka: शतानि अथ सहस्राणि कोट्यः च मम शासनात् ।प्रयान्तु कपि सिंहानाम् निदिशे मम ये स्थिताः ॥४-३७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: śatāni atha sahasrāṇi koṭyaḥ ca mama śāsanāt ।prayāntu kapi siṁhānām nidiśe mama ye sthitāḥ ॥4-37-13॥

translations.english: 'The hundreds of thousands of crores of obedient lionlike monkeys should proceed in all directions at my command.
translations.hindi: तो सैकड़ों हज़ारों ओर करोड़ों श्रेष्ठ वानर मेरे आज्ञानुबती हूँ, वे मेरी आज्ञा से तुरन्त यहाँ चले आवें

verses.sloka: मेघ पर्वत संकाशाः छादयन्त इव अंबरम् ।घोर रूपाः कपि श्रेष्ठा यान्तु मत् शासनात् इतः ॥४-३७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: megha parvata saṁkāśāḥ chādayanta iva aṁbaram ।ghora rūpāḥ kapi śreṣṭhā yāntu mat śāsanāt itaḥ ॥4-37-14॥

translations.english: 'Fierce monkeys, comparable to clouds and mountains in appearance shall go as though covering the sky from here at my command.
translations.hindi: किषिकन्धाकाण्डे आकाश को छा लेने चाले मेघां अथवा पबेतों के सट्टशा डील डौल वाले और भयङ्कर रूपधारी श्रेष्ठवानर मेरी आज्ञा से तुरन्त यहाँ से जाय

verses.sloka: ते गतिज्ञा गतिम् गत्वा पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानराः ।आनयंतु हरीन् सर्वान् त्वरिताः शासनान् मम ॥४-३७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: te gatijñā gatim gatvā pṛthivyām sarva vānarāḥ ।ānayaṁtu harīn sarvān tvaritāḥ śāsanān mama ॥4-37-15॥

translations.english: Let the monkeys who know the regions, knowing their routes, quickly bring at my command all the monkeys upon the earth.

verses.sloka: तस्य वानर राजस्य श्रुत्वा वायु सुतो वचः ।दिक्षु सर्वासु विक्रान्तान् प्रेषयामास वानरान् ॥४-३७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tasya vānara rājasya śrutvā vāyu suto vacaḥ ।dikṣu sarvāsu vikrāntān preṣayāmāsa vānarān ॥4-37-16॥

translations.english: Having heard Sugriva's command, Hanuman, son of the Windgod, sent powerful monkeys in all directions.
translations.hindi: मृत्यु की तरह कपिराज सुग्रीव की उस आज्ञा को सुन कर आर तदनुसार सुग्रीव के भय से त्रस्त हो सब वानर सुग्रीव के पास जाने को प्रस्थानित हुए

verses.sloka: ते पदम् विष्णु विक्रान्तम् पतत्रि ज्योतिः अध्वगाः ।प्रयाताः प्रहिता राज्ञा हरयः तु क्षणेन वै ॥४-३७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: te padam viṣṇu vikrāntam patatri jyotiḥ adhvagāḥ ।prayātāḥ prahitā rājñā harayaḥ tu kṣaṇena vai ॥4-37-17॥

translations.english: The monkeys ordered by the king, traversed the pathway of birds and heavenly bodies, the path Lord Visnu had trod. [Note: the sky is called Vishnupada since Lord Visnu set his foot on the sky in his incarnation as Vamana.]
translations.hindi: सुग्रीव की आज्ञा से वे वानर पत्तियों और नचत्रों के आका - शस्थ साग से उस क्षण रवाना हो गए

verses.sloka: ते समुद्रेषु गिरिषु वनेषु च सरःसु च ।वानरा वानरान् सर्वान् राम हेतोः अचोदयन् ॥४-३७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: te samudreṣu giriṣu vaneṣu ca saraḥsu ca ।vānarā vānarān sarvān rāma hetoḥ acodayan ॥4-37-18॥

translations.english: The messenger monkeys drove in all those living on the sea shore, mountains, forests as well as banks of lakes in order to serve the cause of Rama.

verses.sloka: मृत्यु काल उपमस्य आज्ञाम् राज राजस्य वानराः ।सुग्रीवस्य आययुः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीव भय शन्किताः ॥४-३७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: mṛtyu kāla upamasya ājñām rāja rājasya vānarāḥ ।sugrīvasya āyayuḥ śrutvā sugrīva bhaya śankitāḥ ॥4-37-19॥

translations.english: In response to the command of the king, who was like death to them, the monkeys came at once, driven by fear from Sugriva.

verses.sloka: ततः ते अंजन संकाशा गिरेः तस्मात् महाजवाः ।तिस्रः कोट्यः प्लवंगानाम् निर्ययुर् यत्र राघवः ॥४-३७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ te aṁjana saṁkāśā gireḥ tasmāt mahājavāḥ ।tisraḥ koṭyaḥ plavaṁgānām niryayur yatra rāghavaḥ ॥4-37-20॥

translations.english: Then three crores of swiftfooted monkeys, dark like collyrium, rushed forth to the mountain to meet Rama.

verses.sloka: अस्तम् गच्छति यत्र अर्कः तस्मिन् गिरिवरे रताः ।संतप्त हेम वर्ण आभा तस्मात् कोट्यो दश च्युताः ॥४-३७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: astam gacchati yatra arkaḥ tasmin girivare ratāḥ ।saṁtapta hema varṇa ābhā tasmāt koṭyo daśa cyutāḥ ॥4-37-21॥

translations.english: Ten crores of monkeys shining like pure molten gold, staying on the best of mountains where the Sun sets moved towards Kishkinda.
translations.hindi: पर्वेतश्रे छ अस्ताचल पर जो वानर रहा करते थे और जिनके शारीर का सुनहला रंग था और जो संख्या में दस करोड़ थे, वे भी किष्किन्धा के लिए रवाना हुए

verses.sloka: कैलास शिखरेभ्यः च सिंह केसर वर्चसाम् ।ततः कोटि सहस्राणि वानराणाम् समागमन् ॥४-३७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: kailāsa śikharebhyaḥ ca siṁha kesara varcasām ।tataḥ koṭi sahasrāṇi vānarāṇām samāgaman ॥4-37-22॥

translations.english: From the peaks of Kailasa mountain moved out one thousand crores of monkeys who were of bright colour like the lion's mane.
translations.hindi: केलास शिखर पर वसने वाले वानर भी जिनके शरीर का रंग सिंह के अयाल जेसा था ओर जिनकी संख्या कोटिसहस्त्र थी, किष्किन्धा में आए

verses.sloka: फल मूलेन जीवन्तो हिमवन्तम् उपाश्रिताः ।तेषाम् कोटि सहस्राणाम् सहस्रम् समवर्तत ॥४-३७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: phala mūlena jīvanto himavantam upāśritāḥ ।teṣām koṭi sahasrāṇām sahasram samavartata ॥4-37-23॥

translations.english: Then monkeys residing at mount Himavan feeding on fruits and roots came in thousands of crores. (This number is called Shankha 1000,000,000,000,0, it is one digit higher than Mahapadma.)
translations.hindi: हिमालय-पर्वद-वासी वानर, जो फल मूल खा कर निर्वाह किआ करते थे और जिनकी संख्या अर्वा थी, किष्किन्धा में आए

verses.sloka: अंगारक समानानाम् भीमानाम् भीम कर्मणाम् ।विंध्यात् वानर कोटीनाम् सहस्राणि अपतन् द्रुतम् ॥४-३७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: aṁgāraka samānānām bhīmānām bhīma karmaṇām ।viṁdhyāt vānara koṭīnām sahasrāṇi apatan drutam ॥4-37-24॥

translations.english: From the Vindhya mountain came down thousands of crores of swiftfooted monkeys of terrific deeds. They were fierce like fire (Angaraka).
translations.hindi: विन्धाचलपर रहने वाले वानर, जिनके शरीर का रंग अंगारे जैसा था और जो देखने में भयङ्कर ही न थे, किन्तु भयङ्कर कम करने बाले भो थे और जिनकी संख्या सहस्र करोड़ अथात्‌ एक प्ररे थी, तुरन्त आ पहुँचे

verses.sloka: क्षीर उद वेला निलयाः तमाल वन वासिनः ।नारि केल अशनाः चैव तेषाम् संख्या न विद्यते ॥४-३७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: kṣīra uda velā nilayāḥ tamāla vana vāsinaḥ ।nāri kela aśanāḥ caiva teṣām saṁkhyā na vidyate ॥4-37-25॥

translations.english: The monkeys residents of Tamala forest on the shores of the ocean of milk feeding on coconuts arrived from the groves in countless number.

verses.sloka: वनेभ्यो गह्वरेभ्यः च सरित्भ्यः च महाबलाः ।आगच्छत् वानरी सेना पिबन्ति इव दिवा करम् ॥४-३७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: vanebhyo gahvarebhyaḥ ca saritbhyaḥ ca mahābalāḥ ।āgacchat vānarī senā pibanti iva divā karam ॥4-37-26॥

translations.english: An army of swiftmoving monkeys came from the caves, from the banks of rivers and forests as though it was swallowing up the Sungod.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर अन्न के रस से नाना प्रकार के फूल ऑर फल पैदा हो गए थे । ये अमृत के समान स्वादिष्ट थे और जो कोई एक बार भी इनको खा लेता, तो एक मास तक उसे भूख ही नहां लगती थी ! ( अथवा वह एक मास तक अफरा हुआ रहता था)

verses.sloka: ये तु त्वरयितुम् याता वानराः सर्व वानरान् ।ते वीरा हिमवत् शैले ददृशुः तम् महाद्रुमम् ॥४-३७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: ye tu tvarayitum yātā vānarāḥ sarva vānarān ।te vīrā himavat śaile dadṛśuḥ tam mahādrumam ॥4-37-27॥

translations.english: The monkeys sent earlier to hasten all their counterparts saw mount Himavat from the great tree.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् गिरि वरे पुण्ये यज्ञो माहेश्वरः पुरा ।सर्व देव मनः तोषो बभूव सु मनोरमः ॥४-३७-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin giri vare puṇye yajño māheśvaraḥ purā ।sarva deva manaḥ toṣo babhūva su manoramaḥ ॥4-37-28॥

translations.english: A divine, wonderful, delightful Yagna dedicated to Lord Siva used to be performed on the beautiful (Himalayan) mountain in the past so that the minds of all deities were satisfied.
translations.hindi: जो वानर अन्य सब वानरों को शीघ्रतापूवेके बुलाने को गए थे, उन वीर वानरों ने हिमालय पवत पर एक महावृक्ष जे खन) २७॥ तस्मिन्‌ गिरिवरे रम्ये यहो माहेश्‍वरः पुरा । सबदेवमनस्तोषो बभो दिव्यो मनोहरः

verses.sloka: अन्न निस्यंद जातानि मूलानि च फलानि च ।अमृत स्वादु कल्पानि ददृशुः तत्र वानराः ॥४-३७-२९॥
verses.transliteration: anna nisyaṁda jātāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।amṛta svādu kalpāni dadṛśuḥ tatra vānarāḥ ॥4-37-29॥

translations.english: There the monkeys saw the Yajna, and partook the fruits and roots produced out of the havis which tasted sweet like nectar.

verses.sloka: तत् अन्न संभवम् दिव्यम् फलम् मूलम् मनोहरम् ।यः कश्चित् सकृत् अश्नाति मासम् भवति तर्पितः ॥४-३७-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tat anna saṁbhavam divyam phalam mūlam manoharam ।yaḥ kaścit sakṛt aśnāti māsam bhavati tarpitaḥ ॥4-37-30॥

translations.english: Any one who shares even a little of the divine, delicious fruits and roots grown out of that havis will have no hunger or thirst for a month.

verses.sloka: तानि मूलानि दिव्यानि फलानि च फल अशनाः ।औषधानि च दिव्यानि जगृहुर् हरि पुंगवाः ॥४-३७-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tāni mūlāni divyāni phalāni ca phala aśanāḥ ।auṣadhāni ca divyāni jagṛhur hari puṁgavāḥ ॥4-37-31॥

translations.english: The monkey leaders who lived on fruits collected the divine fruits, roots as well as medicinal herbs.
translations.hindi: फल फल भक्षण करने वाले उन प्रधान प्रधान वानरों ने वे सब दिव्य फल सूल लिए और अनेक प्रकार की जड़ी वू टिया भी लीं, जो वहाँ पर लगी हुइ थीं

verses.sloka: तस्मात् च यज्ञ आयतनात् पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च ।आनिन्युर् वानरा गत्वा सुग्रीव प्रिय कारणात् ॥४-३७-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāt ca yajña āyatanāt puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca ।āninyur vānarā gatvā sugrīva priya kāraṇāt ॥4-37-32॥

translations.english: The monkeys also collected finesmelling flowers from the sacrificial altar to please Sugriva with.

verses.sloka: ते तु सर्वे हरिवराः पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानरान् ।संचोदयित्वा त्वरितम् यूथानाम् जग्मुर् अग्रतः ॥४-३७-३३॥
verses.transliteration: te tu sarve harivarāḥ pṛthivyām sarva vānarān ।saṁcodayitvā tvaritam yūthānām jagmur agrataḥ ॥4-37-33॥

translations.english: The monkey leaders from all over the earth arrived quickly, leading the hordes of them.

verses.sloka: ते तु तेन मुहूर्तेन कपयः शीघ्र चारिणः ।किष्किंधाम् त्वरया प्राप्ताः सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥४-३७-३४॥
verses.transliteration: te tu tena muhūrtena kapayaḥ śīghra cāriṇaḥ ।kiṣkiṁdhām tvarayā prāptāḥ sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ ॥4-37-34॥

translations.english: In a short while the swiftmoving leaders of the monkeys groups reached Kishkinda quickly.
translations.hindi: चे शीघ्र चलने वाले यूथप बात की बात में तुरन्त सुग्रीव के पास किष्किन्धा में आ पहुँचे

verses.sloka: ते गृहीत्वा ओषधीः सर्वाः फल मूलम् च वानराः ।तम् प्रतिग्राहयामासुर् वचनम् च इदम् अब्रुवन् ॥४-३७-३५॥
verses.transliteration: te gṛhītvā oṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ phala mūlam ca vānarāḥ ।tam pratigrāhayāmāsur vacanam ca idam abruvan ॥4-37-35॥

translations.english: Offering all kinds of medicinal herbs, fruits and roots collected, to Sugriva the monkeys said:

verses.sloka: सर्वे परिसृताः शैलाः सरितः च वनानि च ।पृथिव्याम् वानराः सर्वे शासनात् उपयान्ति ते ॥४-३७-३६॥
verses.transliteration: sarve parisṛtāḥ śailāḥ saritaḥ ca vanāni ca ।pṛthivyām vānarāḥ sarve śāsanāt upayānti te ॥4-37-36॥

translations.english: All the mountains, oceans and forests have been covered, and at your command the monkeys upon the earth are coming.
translations.hindi: सवे परिगताः शैलाः समुद्राद वनानि च । पृथिव्यां वानराः सर्वे शासनादुपयाम्ति ते ॥३६'। हम सब ने पर्वेतो, समुद्री और बनों सें जा कर उन स्थानों में रहने बाले बानरों को आपका आदेश सुना दिआ । प्रथिबो के ससस्त वानर आपको आज्ञा को मान, यहाँ पहुँचने ही वाले हैं.

verses.sloka: एवम् श्रुत्वा ततो हृष्टः सुग्रीवः प्लवग अधिपः ।प्रतिजग्राह च प्रीतः तेषाम् सर्वम् उपायनम् ॥४-३७-३७॥
verses.transliteration: evam śrutvā tato hṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavaga adhipaḥ ।pratijagrāha ca prītaḥ teṣām sarvam upāyanam ॥4-37-37॥

translations.english: On hearing the report from the monkeys, Sugriva the king of vanaras, accepted all the gifts they had brought him, with great pleasure. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyseventh sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, of the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
